verdict.rationale: Galileo docs explicitly describe capturing 'every session, trace, and span' with a structured stream, using @log decorators for nested spans, distributed tracing via OTel traceparent to join spans sharing a trace ID, and stitching traces across processes/agents. Multiple cookbooks demonstrate multi-agent LangGraph apps with session-level metrics and multi-step tool-using agent traces, confirming nested spans grouped into sessions/threads in practice. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and a concrete UI screenshot of the nested span/session hierarchy.
